title: Hands-on Exercises
text: This section contains the guided exercises completed for ISSS626. Each exercise page can be extended with R code, maps, explanations, and reflections.

title: Hands-on Exercises
text:
Hands-on Exercise 1A

Geospatial Data Science with R
This exercise focuses on importing and inspecting geospatial data, working with simple feature objects, checking coordinate reference systems, and preparing spatial data for analysis.
Main tools: sf, base R, data wrangling
Status: Page structure prepared for coursework.

title: Hands-on Exercises
text:
Hands-on Exercise 1B

Thematic Mapping and Geovisualisation with R
This exercise focuses on choropleth maps, data classification, colour schemes, map layout, and communicating spatial patterns clearly.
Main tools: tmap, classification methods, cartographic design
Status: Page structure prepared for coursework.

title: Hands-on Exercises
text:
Reproducible workflow
New exercises can be added as individual .qmd files. R code is executed during the local Quarto render, and the generated _site folder is published through Netlify.

title: About
text:
This website is prepared for ISSS626 Geospatial Analytics and Applications. It provides one place for my hands-on exercises, take-home assignments, and course reflections.
The project is developed locally with RStudio, R, Quarto, and Git. Source files are stored in GitHub and the rendered website is deployed to Netlify.

title: About
text:
Website workflow

Write the coursework in RStudio using Quarto .qmd files.
Run the R rendering script to generate the static website.
Commit and push the source and rendered files to GitHub.
Publish the _site folder through Netlify.
